replacement.name: Classic Grande Imphal, a Member of Radisson Individuals
replacement.tagline: 171 rooms with the only proper pool + full-service spa in town, overlooking the Baruni Hill range. The Classic group's Radisson-flagged property — Imphal's lone 4-star with international service standards.

replacement.name: Sangai Continental — The Boutique Hotel
replacement.tagline: 49 rooms on M.G. Avenue at Thangal Bazar, walking distance to Ima Keithel and Kangla Fort. 3-star boutique pitched at business travellers — clean, central, half the price of the Classic Grande.
replacement.address: M.G. Avenue, Thangal Bazar, Imphal West 795001, Manipur

replacement.name: Aurora Boutique Hotel
replacement.tagline: Behind Polo Ground at Paona Bazar — 3km flat walk to Kangla Fort, Govindajee Temple and Ima Keithel. Rooftop restaurant; Booking.com 8.9. The Kangla-Fort walkability anchor.
replacement.address: Paona Bazar, Behind Polo Ground, Imphal West 795001, Manipur

replacement.name: The Classic Hotel
replacement.tagline: Manipur's first 3-star hotel — 1,35,000 sq ft of lawns and open verandas opposite the Kangla Fort gate. The Classic group's flagship before they built the Grande; old-school service from the family that pioneered Manipuri hospitality.
replacement.address: North AOC, Kabo Leikai, Imphal West 795001, Manipur

replacement.name: Sendra Park & Resort by The Classic
replacement.tagline: Four cane-and-water-reed cottages on Sendra hill above Loktak — the only mid-range resort actually on the lake. Sangai Café serves Manipuri thalis with phumdi views; 3km from Moirang.
replacement.address: Sendra Hill, Ithing, Bishnupur District 795133, Manipur

replacement.name: Sendra Tourist Home
replacement.tagline: Manipur Tourism's spartan rest house on Sendra Island with attached cafeteria and Takmu Water Sports next door. Deluxe rooms + cottages; the cheapest sleep with a phumdi view.
replacement.address: Sendra Island, Loktak Lake, Bishnupur District 795133, Manipur

replacement.name: Maipakchao Family Floating Homestay
replacement.tagline: Oinam Maipakchao Singh, 2013 — Thanga island guesthouse run by the president of the local ecotourism board. ₹1000/person includes three meals, hand-rowed boat tours and a working family loom.
replacement.address: Thanga Island, Loktak Lake, Bishnupur District 795133, Manipur

replacement.name: Elora Hotel
replacement.tagline: Tengnoupal district's first 3-star — three floors on Indo-Myanmar Road in Ward No 9, the closest decent bed to the international gate. Clean rooms, hot water, the only credible business stay in town.
replacement.address: Indo-Myanmar Road, Ward No 9, Moreh, Tengnoupal District 795131, Manipur

replacement.name: Apollo Inn
replacement.tagline: Tripadvisor's only listed Tamenglong property — Ward No 1, near Apollo ground, 3km from the main bus stand. Top-floor in-house restaurant; the lone formal lodging in a district where the next bed is 40km away in Imphal.
replacement.address: Ward No 1, Utopia, Tamenglong, Tamenglong District 795141, Manipur

replacement.name: Magen Hills
replacement.tagline: Zone 1 Viewland — Tripadvisor #1 in Ukhrul with a 5/5 rating, garden access and 24-hr front desk. The newest proper boutique in a hill town that mostly runs on basic lodges; closest thing Tangkhul country has to a hotel.
replacement.address: Zone 1, Viewland Bazar, Ukhrul Town, Ukhrul District 795142, Manipur

replacement.name: 25 Degree North Hotel and Restaurant
replacement.tagline: Phungreitang above Gandhi Circle, behind Viewland Church Gate — 2nd-floor rooms over a working restaurant. Tripadvisor #1 Best Value in Ukhrul, MakeMyTrip-bookable, with airport transfer.
replacement.address: 2nd Floor, Behind Viewland Church Gate, Gandhi Circle Lane, Phungreitang, Ukhrul 795142, Manipur

replacement.name: Shalom Lodge
replacement.tagline: Wino Bazar in Hundung — 24-hr front desk, free parking, the cleanest budget bed within walking distance of the Ukhrul main bazaar. Pocket-friendly and hospitable; Goibibo 4.2/79 ratings.
